name: Shawn Elbaz
headline: Chief Technology Officer at ampliphi RMS
about:
I am an aspiring software engineer. I dont like to think of myself as a coder, but as a problem solver. I want to be known as the guy that can solve any problem, regardless of programming language, framework, or stack. I am a problem solver at heart, with a deep interest for everything technology. I am an avid learner and with no plans of stopping. 

I am deeply interested in cybersecurity (penetration testing & social engineering) and healthcare/ biotech. I love the challenge of new projects. Always trying to keep up to date with the latest news about the AI, LLMs, finance and equities, HFT & Event Driven Trading, Ad Networks (DSP, SSP).

Full Stack Software Developer with experience in .Net Core, Python, Java, Javascript, Typescript, C#, and C++ in an Agile environment.
Using technologies like Angular, Express, MySQL, MongoDB, Node.js, Redis, Postgres, Webpack, Docker.
Familiar with Azure Cloud Services, Serverless functions and orchestrations, CosmosDB and StorageTables, API management... and just about any service needed to get the job done. 

I personally love travelling to different countries, trekking, taking pictures and exploring the unknown.
